notes.title: Little Nightmares III - Extended Stories
notes.content:
Little Nightmares continues to expand beyond video games. Several other projects have been announced during Little Nightmares Showcase on June 24, spanning a variety of media such as comic books, podcasts and more. 

The Sounds of Nightmares

The Sounds of Nightmares, the podcast series that has surpassed 2 million listens, will receive a second season which is currently being written.

[previewyoutube="yzX5UrnKGj4;full"][/previewyoutube]

Little Nightmares: Descent to Nowhere

Little Nightmares: Descent to Nowhere, the comic book series published by Titan Comics will be releasing the first issue in October 2025. The comic follows two parallel stories. Hush, a timid mute girl wakes up in a jail cell. Desperate to escape, she befriends another prisoner, Mono, who understands this world far better than her, they will have to find a way out of a very dark Dungeon. 

Elsewhere, Myra is a detective exhausted by life who meets someone who reignites her will to make a difference. They resume investigating unresolved cases of children vanishing year after year without a trace.

[previewyoutube="FK30jqgA_oM;full"][/previewyoutube]

The comic book series will be published in English and will be available for pre-purchase starting in July at your local comic bookstore and worldwide on Titan’s website. 



Little Nightmares: The Lonely Ones

Little Nightmares: The Lonely Ones, the young adult horror novel written by E.C. Myers and published by Scholastic will be out in September 2025. It follows Ruse, a young child, who awakens in an unfamiliar, shaking room with two other kids she doesn't know—a small girl with a frayed rope dangling from her neck and a starved-looking boy wearing a tattered mask over his mouth and nose. She is in a nightmarish carnival and knows one thing: it's not safe, and she needs to flee. Will she be able to make it out? Will her companions of misfortune reveal themselves to be friends or enemies? 

As a final surprise, a teaser for a stop motion project developed in collaboration with the studio Taller del Chucho has been shown with more information to be unveiled later.

[previewyoutube="Y4CM3i39Z08;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Little Nightmares available today on mobile, on iOS, and Android 📱
notes.content:
The charming horror adventure tale Little Nightmares is now available on mobile, for players to enjoy everywhere!

In Little Nightmares, you will have to help Six escape The Maw – a vast, mysterious vessel inhabited by corrupted souls who don’t approve of wayward children. As you progress through your journey, untangle each room's tricky puzzles, hide in the shadows of the monsters' lairs and use your imagination to stay out of harm's way!

Bandai Namco Europe has worked with Playdigious, a developer known for its mobile adaptations of successful games from console and PC, to bring the atmospheric puzzle platformer to iOS and Android. 

This port is tailored for mobile devices to offer the most comfortable and immersive experience for mobile players.

[previewyoutube=gUEILRgdx_A;full][/previewyoutube]

The game has been carefully adapted for mobile with a revamped interface, Game Center achievements, mobile cloud save and 3 Control modes.

Discover the different ways you'll be able to explore the Maw on mobile, on iOS and Android phones.

[previewyoutube=C97nkoqdHb8;full][/previewyoutube]


 Controller Mode offers users the possibility of playing with MFi controllers (controllers made for Apple devices) while two new Control modes let you to play with the touchscreen.
 Standard Mode lets you play with the various controls appearing on the screen...
...while Immersive Mode offers greater immersion in the game's atmosphere. 



Special Mobile Launch Giveaway

In celebration of the release, we’re giving away 30 copies of the mobile version – 15 for iOS and 15 for Android – to 30 lucky children who register for the contest here on our site.

Join in by December 19, 2023 for your chance to win a copy for yourself or download the game on the app store of your choice on December 12, 2023!

notes.title: Dive into an unforgettable nightmare with the Enhanced Edition ✨
notes.content:
Over two million visitors have traveled to the Pale City with Mono and Six in the months since Little Nightmares II was released.

Now, we have a special treat for good little children. The Little Nightmares II: Enhanced Edition offers these visitors a way to take advantage of more powerful hardware for an even deeper dive into a beautifully distorted world where all your bad dreams come true.

If you already own Little Nightmares II, then this Enhanced Edition is already available to you for no additional charge. If you haven’t purchased the game yet, it will be included in your digital copy of Little Nightmares II.


What does this new edition do? 

This update for Little Nightmares II has four features that will surround you with the sights and sounds of the Pale City like never before. Allow us to elaborate. 

Ray-Traced Reflections let you see live reflections in shiny surfaces throughout the game, like the cold, damp tiles of the Hospital wards or the dull glass of a deactivated TV. 

Improved Volumetric Shadows add even more depth and detail to every object and enhance how rays of light are interrupted by moving objects, like the Hunter ripping away at his prey in front of his boarded-up workshop window or the Doctor tending to his patients under a swinging ceiling lamp. 

Interactive Particles dance and swirl realistically through the air as characters move through a scene. It’s so evocative you might almost feel the need to sneeze when landing on a dusty rug in the attic or flinch when motes of burning ash spills through a furnace vent.  

Immersive Audio wraps you in a three-dimensional soundscape if you’re using 5.1 or 7.1 speakers or headphones. You’ll hear each echoing swat of the Teacher’s ruler getting closer and closer as you creep through the School’s air ducts and track the clatter of hordes of Patients as they snatch at you from the dark.  

The combination of all these features creates a masterful experience rendered in crisp 4k resolution. 


How to launch Little Nightmares II Enhanced Edition:

After the release of “Little Nightmares II - Enhanced Edition”, you will be able to choose between the original game and the Enhanced Edition.

First off, if you want to launch the Enhanced Edition, don’t launch the game from the desktop shortcut. Please only launch the game from the library or you will not be able to play the Enhanced Edition.  

When starting the game from the library, a launcher will pop up and let you choose between “Little Nightmares II” and “Little Nightmares II - Enhanced Edition”.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39095424/fc7a80a4b37772c646c6cb1a020d9b17281f2f0e.png

If the launcher does not pop-up:
Please verify that the Enhanced Edition is available and activated in your DLC list.  

On the library page, open the DLC section and enable “Little Nightmares II – Enhanced Edition” if this DLC is disabled. Alternatively, you can right click on “Little Nightmares II” in the game library, then select Proprieties > DLC to access this menu. 
 

We hope you enjoy this Enhanced version of Little Nightmares II and all the little details of the world waiting to be revealed to you in your Enhanced playthrough. Thank you so much to the entire Little Nightmares community for supporting the franchise over the past four years, your passion has allowed it to grow beyond our wildest dreams!

[previewyoutube=TEfOYtm40gM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Little Nightmares 2's free Enhanced Edition update out today on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S

notes.title: Little Nightmares II - Game Patch Released
notes.content:
Global

 Fixed a bug where Six responds to calls during cooperative long-jump moments resulting in failure to catch the player.
 Fixed language issues in the trophies of the Traditional and Simplified Chinese versions. 
 Fixed a bug where some objects would disappear, especially when the player died and respawned.


Wilderness

 Fixed a bug where the key could not be retrieved in the Cabin Attic if the player restarted from checkpoint at a specific moment.
 Visual fix for a floating rope in the Cabin Attic key puzzle.
 Footstep animation fix for Six in the toolshed scene before the raft ride.


School

 Visual fix for lung floating in the air after the Teacher inserts it into the biology model.
 Visual fix for the Teacher not picking up chalk when writing on a chalkboard.
 Adjusted audio parameters on a wiggling drawer to avoid sound corruption.
 Adjusted geometry so that Six doesn’t get stuck on a railing in the schoolyard.
 Taught Six how to get down from the top of a goalpost in the schoolyard.
 Allowed Bullies in the Teacher’s study to go around the shelf so they don’t get stuck.
 Disallowed player from standing on a column frame to skip the puzzle in the Biology room.


Hospital

 Fuse no longer appears early in the Hospital hub when the player follows a very specific set of steps.
 Fixed a bug where the achievement “Objection” does not unlock if the player dies while unlocking the achievement.
 Ensured that the elevator doors can open for the player if they reload from a checkpoint near the small incinerator below the X-Ray room.
 Ensured that the elevator and switch will reset if the player reloads from a checkpoint near the big incinerator at the end of the Hospital chapter.
 Fixed a bug where the player can survive from the fall from the crawlspace down into the Morgue. Sorry, speedrunners.
 Adjusted the way that stuffed animals are put into the incinerator to ensure that the key appears when many stuffed animals are put in at once.
 Visual fix for the patient animation when the Doctor comes to the room after unplugging the respirator.
 Visual fix for the X-Ray machine not rendering correctly on all aspect ratios.
 Visual fix for light not flickering above the electric chair.


Pale City

 Fixed a bug where televisions would not respond to the remote if the player happened to die just as they touched the screen.
 Blocked a level escape (fall through the world) behind the collapsing ceiling scene.
 Adjusted rubble that allowed the player to reach a door handle without Six’s help.
 Adjusted checkpoint trigger for the cooperative clothesline puzzle so the player cannot skip the puzzle by dying.
 Fixed a bug where Viewers were being de-spawned in the street if the player backtracked after solving the electric water puzzle in the shopping area.
 Extended grabbable surface around the backside of a TV so that it is less frustrating to climb up it.


Transmission Tower

 Fixed a texture issue during the ending cinematic.

notes.title: Little Nightmares II is out now 📺
notes.content:
Journey to the source of the Transmission and face your fate.

In a dark and crumbling city, a boy named Mono is seeking the source of a sinister broadcast. He’ll have the help of a girl named Six, who accompanies him after he rescues her from a rotting basement.

Together, they’ll work to solve puzzles, escape the grotesque monsters hunting them, and travel to the heart of the Pale City.

The best charming horror game of 2021 is available now, don’t miss it!
